focuses.name: Boost The Grand Council Of Fascism
Economia di Guerra
focuses.description: We unleash the full might of our economy, mobilizing every resource and industry to forge a war machine unparalleled in history. Our nation rises as a mighty industrial powerhouse, ready to conquer any foe that dares stand in our path.

focuses.name: Politica dei Consorzi
focuses.description: Let us forge a grand alliance of industries, intertwining our strengths and expertise to propel our nation to new heights. We cultivate collaboration, nurture innovation, and build a foundation of industrial might that carries us to victory.

focuses.name: Nazionalismo Scientifico-Tecnico
focuses.description: We embrace the synergy between science and nationalism propelling our nation forward with revolutionary discoveries and cutting-edge technologies.

focuses.name: Sindacato Unico Fascista
focuses.description: United we stand, unyielding and resolute in our labor's pursuit of greatness. We establish a formidable trade union, a collective force that inspires discipline, empowers productivity, and ensures the unwavering loyalty of our workforce.

focuses.name: Istituto Nazionale di Finanza Corporativa
focuses.description: With the establishment of the "Istituto Nazionale di Finanza Corporativa," we take control of our financial destiny. Through strategic oversight and investment, we empower our corporations, strengthen our economy, and secure the foundation of our national prosperity.

focuses.name: Clima dell'Azione
focuses.description: Fueled by patriotic zeal, we unite our nation, stirring the hearts of Italians to achieve greatness.

focuses.name: Società Finanziaria Siderurgica
focuses.description: Let us strengthen the mighty steel industry of Italy through the creation of a state-owned financial corporation.

focuses.name: Rete Autostradale Italiana
focuses.description: We forge a vast network of highways and roadways across Italy, binding our nation together. These arteries of progress empower our people, fuel our economy, and unite our land.

focuses.name: Asse Roma-Berlino
focuses.description: Together, we cement the unbreakable bond between Italy and Germany. Bound by a shared vision of greatness, we march side by side, exchanging military wisdom, forging economic might, and standing as an indomitable force that shapes the destiny of nations.

focuses.name: A New Era For The Red Shirts
